name: Drift Detection
description: Can you catch drift? A time series has been injected with a distribution shift. Find where.

challenge.question: A model's accuracy was [0.95, 0.94, 0.96, 0.93, 0.95, 0.45, 0.42, 0.38]. Where did drift occur?

feedback.correct: Sharp eye! The distribution shifted at index 5 — a 50%+ accuracy drop is classic drift.
feedback.incorrect: Look for the largest discontinuity in the sequence. The jump from 0.95 to 0.45 is the signal.
